title: From Fulton Street to BUILT

captions.instagram:
From my father's Fulton Street store to BUILT®, in one swipe.

Brooklyn. The youngest of ten. Our family store in Spanish Harlem. Four stores of my own by 16. The first Wiz in 1976. Waterfront and real estate. JemRock Organization. BUILT®, unveiled in August 2026 and presented at the United Nations.

#Brooklyn #Entrepreneurship #Housing

captions.facebook:
52 weeks of carousels, one story: Brooklyn, family, retail, real estate and housing. Thank you for following along.

#Entrepreneurship #Brooklyn

captions.linkedin:
Every chapter built on the last one.

I was born and raised in Brooklyn, the youngest of ten. I worked beside my father, Norman, in our family store in Spanish Harlem, and by 16 I had started four electronics and music stores. In 1976, my father opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street. As the chain grew, I built an in-house construction and fixture company. After the Wiz came waterfront revitalization and real estate, then JemRock Organization.

In August 2026 we unveiled BUILT®, and I presented it at the United Nations. Our work has also been featured in The Real Deal.

#Entrepreneurship #Housing
